title: Declare engine marker activation incompatible with the published CLI
summary: Published `@inventarch/cli` 2.0.0 reads distribution engine 0.1.0. This successor uses engine 0.1.1, distinct from npm 3.0.0 and native 2.1.0. It can read compatible exact old locks without rewriting them, but new initialization with --apply and every applied install, update or remove, including an applied no-op update, activate an engine 0.1.1 lock. The published CLI then refuses reads of that workspace before writing, even when unchanged package versions remain locked. Archive engine requirements stay strict. Older doctor, recover and restore commands cannot upgrade their running CLI or understand newer host journal formats; host removal alone cannot restore engine compatibility. Before upgrading, retain a complete workspace and state backup, its exact archives and the matching old CLI. For downgrade, finish pending recovery and necessary owned host cleanup with the newer CLI, then restore the complete pre-upgrade backup and use its matching old CLI. Preserve authored bytes, archive pins and ranges; never edit an engine marker to bypass the reader. No publication is performed by these migration instructions.
